blocks.content: Quiz: Which of the following statements is true for the abstract method?
Tap an option below to answer:
An abstract method is created using the abstract keyword.
We use the abstract keyword to create an abstract method.
We use the abstract keyword to create an abstract method.
The body of an abstract method is replaced by a semicolon.
The syntax of abstract method is abstract void method(); where the body is replaced by a semicolon.
The syntax of abstract method is abstract void method(); where the body is replaced by a semicolon.
Both A and B are the correct statements for abstract methods.
Both A and B are the correct statements for abstract methods.
One of the above options is the correct answer.
One of the above options is the correct answer.
